items.title: How Long Can Rocket Lab Stock Wait On Neutron?
items.summary: Rocket Lab (RKLB) has fallen about 49% over the past three months, while signing the biggest launch contract in its history. The risk sits in the gap between those two facts. The threat is not on the demand side. It is that the company spends far ahead of Neutron, the rocket meant to turn its cash around, and Neutron has not flown.

items.title: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Wins Pentagon Deal To Triple Patriot Missile Production
items.summary: Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) won a multi year, multi billion dollar Pentagon contract to triple production of its Patriot missile systems. The award comes as U.S. and Iran relations remain strained and demand for air and missile defense capacity draws greater attention. The contract further anchors Lockheed Martin's role as a core supplier to U.S. and allied defense programs focused on regional security.
